summary: MCP server tích hợp cho DaVinci Resolve Studio, cho phép tự động hóa và điều khiển quy trình dựng màu qua giao thức MCP.
usecases: Automated color grading workflows for post-production pipelines
Integration between DaVinci Resolve and custom AI/ML tools for frame-by-frame analysis
Batch processing and rendering automation for large-scale video projects
ideas: Build a web dashboard to monitor and trigger Resolve operations remotely via MCP
Combine with NLP models to generate edit suggestions based on metadata
Create a plugin ecosystem where multiple developers can extend MCP actions for Resolve
